verdict.rationale: The Locations API clearly supports creating and managing locations programmatically (square-docs-9, square-docs-24), which an agent could call via SDK (square-gh-1). However, there is no evidence of an API to register or pair physical readers/hardware to a location — Terminal API docs cover taking payments on already-provisioned hardware (square-docs-28, square-docs-26), not device registration/enrollment. Missing for 10: a documented Devices/reader registration API endpoint, evidence of programmatic reader pairing/provisioning, and an end-to-end example combining location creation with reader registration.
